{{See also|Foxconn|105b|Lenovo|17aa}} {{#set:Probable Linux driver=ath12k}} ==Links of Interest== *[https://www.tomshardware.com/null/gigabytes-wi-fi-7-pcie-card-lets-you-prep-your-old-pc-for-tomorrows-wireless-standard ''Gigabyte AORUS GC-WIFI7'' on '''THW'''] *[https://www.techpowerup.com/316673/gigabyte-intros-aorus-gc-wifi7-pcie-wlan-card-supporting-up-to-5800-mbps-bandwidth-comes-with-a-hardware-lottery ''Gigabyte AORUS GC-WIFI7'' on '''TPU'''] ==Notes== ===Key Features=== *Built-in Wi-Fi 7 module, PCIe x1 Interface Card, Bluetooth 5.3 compatible *Complies with 802.11abgn/ac/ax/be standards, supports MU-MIMO TX/RX *Supports high-speed wireless connections of up to 5800Mbps *Offers up to 320MHz bandwidth support across the 2.4, 5 and 6GHz bands *MLO (Multi-Link Operation) enables simultaneous connections on two bands *MRU (Multiple RU) enhances interference mitigation and OFDMA efficiency *4K-QAM allows for higher transmission rates, resulting in increased efficiency *Equipped with an ultra-high gain 2Tx2R antenna, supporting both directional :and omnidirectional signals ==See also== :;[[List of 802.11be Hardware]] *[[Gigabyte AORUS GC-WBAX1200]] (AMD RZ608) *[[Gigabyte AORUS GC-WBAX200]] ([[Intel]] AX200) *[[Gigabyte AORUS GC-WBAX210]] ([[Intel]] AX210) *[[Gigabyte GC-WBAX2400R]] (AX2400) *[[Gigabyte GC-WB1733D]] (AC1733) *[[Qualcomm QCNCM865]] (''FastConnect 7800'') • Wi-Fi 7 (NCM865/NVM865) :''Qualcomm WiFi 7/BT Combo Module'' • [[Qualcomm]] WCN7851 :FCC ID: J9C-QCNCM865 (2023-04-05) *[[MediaTek MT7927]] ([[AMD]] RZ738) • Wi-Fi 7 (MT7927BEW) BW320 :''2TX 11be (WiFi 7) BW320 + BT/BLE Combo Card'' :FCC ID: RAS-MT7927 (2023-01-18) • ''Filogic 380'' *[[Intel WiFi 7 BE200 (BE200NGW)]] • Wi-Fi 7 (MT7) BW320 • [https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/products/sku/230078/intel-wifi-7-be200/specifications.html PPage] :''2TX 11be (WiFi 7) BW320 + BT/BLE Combo Card'' :FCC ID: PD9BE200NG (2023-08-15) [[Category:English Documentation]]
